cmake -B build && cmake --build build

review.editorial_summary: Completed the C++ LAS implementation; unchanged source passes 215/223 under LAS 2.0.4. Remaining gaps: absent-waveform validation, waveform interval checks.
review.notes:
Completed the C++ inspector/renderer after repairing intermediate build/link/self-test problems. It intentionally omitted waveform interval validation after overreading the opaque-packet exemption. The LAS 2.0.4 result remains 215/223, matching the prior 2.0.3 score. The original generation grade was 213/219 under LAS 2.0.1. This official zero-inference regrade uses the committed 2.0.4 suite and the pinned offline Docker image. Its complete 223-node outcome mapping matches the independently validated scratch report. All 222 unchanged node outcomes match the 2.0.3 baseline; only the renamed negative is semantically replaced. The new negative declares external waveform storage while retaining internal packet data and keeps the internal bit clear; it does not duplicate the both-bits-set check. Acceptance/rejection solely for a clear deprecated internal bit remains unscored.  Remaining source defects: A waveform descriptor/storage mode is required from the point format before recognizing descriptor index 0 as no associated waveform. This one implementation defect is observed in formats 4, 5, 9 and 10. Inspect/render accept both EVLR-header overlap and payload overflow; packet layout being opaque does not exempt the declared storage interval. Full original transcript/source reviews are carried forward with their reviewer, content hash and path below. Those earlier reviews are historical evidence; their former tool-count exactness claims are superseded by the current session-based audit. The exact tool-call total is unavailable because preserved failed-wrapper evidence is ambiguous; tool_calls and tool_calls_definition are null. The original canonical baseline 88 remains only in the audit, not an exact-count claim. Input, output, cache and reasoning totals reparse exactly and remain complete; all token/cost fields and generation metadata are preserved. Regrading adds no model calls or generation cost. Original result/source/session/raw reports and previous regrade history remain unchanged. Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

Tool-call total is unavailable because failed-wrapper evidence cannot establish an exact count; the prior canonical baseline is retained only in the audit. Token totals, reasoning counts and generation cost are unchanged; original usage and session hashes are preserved in the regrade audit.

payload.editorial_summary: Implemented LAS 1.4 inspection and rendering; audited LAS 2.0.3 regrade passed 215/223 using unchanged generated source.
payload.notes: Original generation completed normally under LAS 2.0.1 (213/219), with every transcript message, command outcome and relevant output reviewed. Canonical events and richer sessions reproduce all recorded input/output/cache/reasoning tokens and underlying tool-call counts; API-only audit and launch hashes verified. Original result and source/test manifests for the official zero-inference regrade are verified. LAS 2.0.2 repaired shared waveform offsets and underspecified representations and added four interval checks; LAS 2.0.3 makes the oversized Extra Bytes negative explicit, avoiding an unspecified omitted-tail default. Historical scores, generation metadata and usage remain preserved. LAS 2.0.2 scored 214/223;2.0.3 scores 215/223 because the program correctly rejects an explicit one-byte tail against a two-byte descriptor. Inferring and zero-filling an entirely omitted tail is no longer penalized. Eight genuine remaining failures: four absent-waveform files rejected for unnecessary flags/descriptors, plus all four inspect/render header-overlap and payload-overflow checks. The transcript explicitly omitted offset validation after overinterpreting the opaque-packet exemption, and source inspection confirms it. Intermediate build/link/self-test failures were repaired before completion. Recorded usage: 11, 479, 669 total tokens, 62, 106 reasoning tokens, 88 tool calls, estimated $0.408439.

editorial.last_message: Implemented LAS 1.4 inspection and rendering; audited LAS 2.0.3 regrade passed 215/223 using unchanged generated source.
editorial.notes:
Original generation completed normally under LAS 2.0.1 (213/219), with every transcript message, command outcome and relevant output reviewed. Canonical events and richer sessions reproduce all recorded input/output/cache/reasoning tokens and underlying tool-call counts; API-only audit and launch hashes verified. Original result and source/test manifests for the official zero-inference regrade are verified. LAS 2.0.2 repaired shared waveform offsets and underspecified representations and added four interval checks; LAS 2.0.3 makes the oversized Extra Bytes negative explicit, avoiding an unspecified omitted-tail default. Historical scores, generation metadata and usage remain preserved. LAS 2.0.2 scored 214/223;2.0.3 scores 215/223 because the program correctly rejects an explicit one-byte tail against a two-byte descriptor. Inferring and zero-filling an entirely omitted tail is no longer penalized. Eight genuine remaining failures: four absent-waveform files rejected for unnecessary flags/descriptors, plus all four inspect/render header-overlap and payload-overflow checks. The transcript explicitly omitted offset validation after overinterpreting the opaque-packet exemption, and source inspection confirms it. Intermediate build/link/self-test failures were repaired before completion. Recorded usage: 11, 479, 669 total tokens, 62, 106 reasoning tokens, 88 tool calls, estimated $0.408439.

Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

Tool-call total is unavailable: failed-wrapper evidence cannot establish an exact total. The prior canonical baseline and proven attempts are retained in the audit, not displayed as an exact count. Token totals, reasoning counts and cost are unchanged. Original usage and complete prior publication bytes are preserved in the linked tool-count audit.
